jyutping: m4 cam4 soeng4 ge3 dei6 fong1

english.note: This is the all-purpose noun phrase for the unusual aspect or quality of a person, thing, or situation.

examples.english: I could see the unusualness of this painting at a glance.
examples.traditional: 我一眼就睇出呢幅畫唔尋常嘅地方。
